desc: HAPPO (ICLR 2022 / JMLR 2024) on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B1.
Host block == ippo/config1.json, so an arm difference is not a tuning
difference. The 'happo' block is HARL's own defaults from
harl/configs/algos_cfgs/happo.yaml, except where URB's config already
fixes the quantity (lr, clip_eps, entropy_coef, num_epochs, widths).
episode_length: null -> the host's batch_size, i.e. HAPPO collects as
many fresh days per update as URB's IPPO does.
ppo_epoch: null -> the host's num_epochs (happo.yaml says 5; using the
host's keeps the number of passes over the data equal across arms).
